epubExport1.title: (Kindle 1)
epubExport1.hint: Конвертация FB2 → EPUB и отправка на Kindle через fb2converter
epubExport1.cmd: cp '${HASHFILE}.raw' '${FILENAME}'; ${EXTDIR}/app-fb2c/fb2c -c ${EXTDIR}/app-fb2c/configuration.toml convert --to epub --ow --stk --nodirs '${FILENAME}' '${EXTDIR}/app-export'; mv -f conversion.log '${EXTDIR}/log/'; rm -f ./*
